fix_attempts.issue: Test collection error: scripts.seed_master_data import triggered get_settings(), which required DATABASE_URL env var (unset in test env).
fix_attempts.root_cause: T-009 conftest.py did not seed a placeholder DATABASE_URL before src.* imports; src.infrastructure.db.session calls get_settings() at module load.
fix_attempts.fix: Added os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'postgresql+psycopg://test:test@localhost:5432/test_placeholder') at top of backend/tests/conftest.py.

fix_attempts.issue: Jest could not load jest.config.ts (no ts-node installed).
fix_attempts.root_cause: Sprint-scaffold delivered jest.config.ts but did not add ts-node as a dev dependency.
fix_attempts.fix: Added frontend/jest.config.js (CJS form, identical content to .ts). Tests invoked with `npx jest --config jest.config.js`. Original .ts retained for IDE typing.

fix_attempts.issue: TC-045 (DesignGradeMapPage 409 toast) crashed with `candidate?.scrollIntoView is not a function`.
fix_attempts.root_cause: jsdom does not implement Element.prototype.scrollIntoView; Radix UI Select component calls it on focus.
fix_attempts.fix: Added one-line polyfill to frontend/jest.setup.ts: `Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = function () {}`.

fix_attempts.issue: After polyfill, TC-045 still couldn't find dropdown option — Radix Select portal not openable via fireEvent.click in jsdom.
fix_attempts.root_cause: Radix Select uses pointer-event-based open mechanics that jsdom can't fully drive; test was over-coupled to UI internals when the TC's assertion is about the page's 409 toast behavior.
fix_attempts.fix: Mocked DesignGradeMapForm in the test file to render a minimal submit-only form with a fixed payload. Test now focuses on the page-level mutation/toast path per the TC's intent.

gate_details: All TCs with priority=critical passed (39/39 critical + 7/7 high). No regressions (S1 is the first sprint).
